sentences.en: Some cruise ships emit as much particulate matter as 1m cars.
sentences.zh: 一些游轮排放的颗粒物相当于一百万辆汽车的排放量。

sentences.en: The air quality report warned about high levels of particulate pollution today.
sentences.zh: 空气质量报告警告今天存在较高的颗粒物污染水平。

sentences.en: She prefers a mask that filters out fine particulate matter for better health.
sentences.zh: 她更喜欢使用能过滤掉细小颗粒物的口罩以保持健康。
